description: Scan the venue's listed instruments for ones matching conditions, instead of looking at the open chart. Rules combine price fields, any indicator plot, or a formula expression, with ALL/ANY matching. This is the tool for "which coins are doing X right now". It fetches history for every instrument in the universe, so it is slow and worth asking for once with the right conditions rather than repeatedly with narrower ones.

manualSymbols.description: Optional symbols forced into the universe before current-volume ranking.

market.description: Defaults to the chart. Perpetuals are futures.

order.description: With sortBy. Default desc; asc for the biggest losers.

right.description: A number, or another operand in the same form as left.

sortBy.description: Order the matches before the limit, e.g. change24h for top movers. Default: universe order (volume).

name: screener_run
